spans.s: --a son of Krodha and a deva gandharva. Br.
(I)--the presiding deity of Sarvarohahara cakra. Br. IV. ३७. 9.

. २५५; IV. २०. ४६; ३०. 9; ३३, 3, ३९. ५६.
wander in this world in the guise of Brahmans; hence guests must be fed worthy of them; devas are योगेश्वरस् and move for the promotion of dharma in different guises.
7: वा. २३. १९१; ३०. ८८, ३४. २१; ३८. ५८. ४७. ४६; ७१. ७४; ७२. ३५.
(I)--on the banks of the Ganges. M. ११०. १२.

(II)--in the हिमालयस्;
1: वा. २३. १७५, १८२.
where Yogins go with their very bodies or कायारोहणम्.
2: Ib. २३. २२२.
--the holy spot on the सरस्वती where देवभूति attained निर्वाण। भा. III. ३३. ३१. [page३-598+ २५]

--(Svarga)
1: वा. ४१. ८१-2.
the permanent residence of नारद.
2: भा. IV. २९. ८०.
--a तीर्थ sacred to the पितृस्. M. २२. ५५.
(I)--a son of मणिभद्र and पुण्यजनी: an यक्ष. Br.
(II)--a daughter of दक्ष; married Dharma; mother of Sukha. Br.
(IV)--a देवी in the चक्रराजरथ. Br. IV. १९. 4.

--eighteen in number of which ten are the principles of गुणस्, and eight depend on Hari. These are अणिमा, महिमा, लघिमा, प्राकाश्य, ईशित्व, वशित: other siddhis enumerated: All these are consequences of yoga. भा. XI. १
--the wife of Matanga and mother of लघुश्याम. Br. IV. ३१. १०३.
